task.name: Security Advisory Triage Enforcement
task.description: Review newly published repository security advisories and surface only advisories that remain untriaged after the repository's required operator triage window without an already tracked or explicitly accepted exception.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent discovering unattended published security advisories while avoiding duplicate attention on triage gaps that are already tracked or explicitly accepted.
activationConditions: A security advisory is published or transitions into the repository's operator-triage queue within the evidence window in a covered repository.
Authoritative repository advisory evidence shows the advisory has no qualifying triage disposition before the repository's configured triage deadline.
requiredEffects: Each novel triage-enforcement finding identifies the advisory, the operator-triage queue membership evidence, the configured triage deadline, and the absence of a qualifying triage disposition before that deadline.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: No covered operator-triaged security advisory has exceeded the configured triage deadline.
Every supported security-advisory-triage finding for the covered overdue advisories is already tracked or explicitly accepted.
successConditions: Supported security-advisory-triage findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within 7 days of the workflow run.
Advisories that received a qualifying triage disposition before the deadline create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A repository may define a qualifying triage disposition narrowly, for example requiring severity classification and owner assignment rather than a generic acknowledgment.
A documented incident response exception may intentionally pause the triage clock for one advisory during a coordinated disclosure while still requiring explicit acceptance evidence.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel security-advisory-triage findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 7 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported security-advisory-triage findings it assigns for overdue covered operator-triaged security advisories.
acceptedEvidence: A maintainer triage event, advisory timeline event, or linked repository record showing the identified advisory received a qualifying triage disposition after the finding and before the evidence cutoff.
A closed tracking issue, advisory conversation, or repository-linked exception record that explicitly marks the security-advisory-triage finding resolved, dismissed, or accepted by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-security-advisory-triage-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported security-advisory-triage findings / supported novel security-advisory-triage findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 7 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel security-advisory-triage finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned security-advisory-triage finding set or required repository advisory and timeline evidence for overdue covered operator-triaged security advisories cannot be read.
